For a solar generator kit under $1,500, I'd prioritize a system with at least 1,000Wh of battery capacity, 1,800W or more of AC output, LiFePO4 batteries, and a bundled solar panel.

The best choice depends on whether you're buying it for home backup during outages, camping/RV use, or off-grid power. At this budget, you can get a capable system from EcoFlow, Bluetti, Jackery, or Anker.

One important distinction: a solar generator kit should include both the power station and solar panels. Some attractive deals include only the battery unit.
